frames.name: plate_vivian_library
frames.prompt: Location: a sunlit Old-Money mahogany home library. Camera: eye level (about 1.2 m high), about 2.5 m from a mahogany writing desk, 35mm lens, a MEDIUM shot. Composition from bottom to top: the front edge of the desk runs straight across the lower 25% of the frame; on the desk a closed leather-bound household ledger at lower-right and a warm glowing brass banker desk lamp at the left edge; directly behind the desk, centered, an EMPTY high-backed leather desk chair facing the camera, leaving clear space for one seated person from the waist up; behind that, floor-to-ceiling leather-bound book spines and wood-paneled walls in soft T2.2 bokeh, warm window sunlight from the left. Keep the top 20% of the frame as calm background (bookshelves).

frames.name: plate_wen_counter
frames.prompt: Location: a small, old San Francisco neighborhood tea shop, an ordinary shop, no temple, no incense, no gongs. Camera: eye level (about 1.4 m high), about 1.5 m from the wooden tea counter, 50mm lens, a MEDIUM CLOSE shot. Composition from bottom to top: the front edge of the worn wooden counter runs straight across the lower 18% of the frame; on the counter, both props sit NEAR THE CENTER of the frame, close together: a small brown clay teapot just left of center and ONE small white porcelain cup of amber oolong with a thin wisp of steam just right of center, the two about a hand-width apart; directly behind the counter, centered, EMPTY space for one standing person seen from the mid-chest up; behind that, a wall of tea tins and paper-labelled jars in soft T2.2 bokeh, soft window daylight. Keep the top 18% of the frame as calm background.
